column1: # Scripts CI may install into /usr/local/bin on the data server, and nothing else.
# DEST<TAB>SRC, one per line. SRC is read from origin/main, never from a runner's tree.
# Ruled 2026-11-02: CI gets write access to the production script directory ONLY
# through a named allowlist. This file is that list, and it is the whole scope:
#   - sudo enforces it, not the workflow. config/sudoers.d/ktp-ci-install is
#     generated from this file and grants one exact command per row.
#   - Adding a row takes a merged PR AND the operator reinstalling the sudoers
#     fragment, so CI cannot widen its own grant. Until both land, the new row's
#     install is refused by sudo and the workflow goes red.
#   - Removing a row takes effect at once: ktp-ci-install reads this file at the
#     verified tip of main and refuses anything it does not name.
# What belongs here: reporting and analysis scripts whose worst merged mistake is a
# wrong report. What does not: anything that deletes, restarts, reboots, backs up or
# pushes off-box; anything that alerts or watches (the witness must not be updated
# by what it witnesses); the installer and the runner's own heartbeat (denied in
# code as well). Each row must already have a manifest row from a person's install.
